skills.name: Upjohn
skills.description: Properly identifies representation and role with the Company, and that they cannot give the employee legal advice. This must always be part of the very beginning of the interview.
skills.reason: T2 gave the full warning at the very start: the Committee and company are the clients, not the witness personally, and counsel cannot give legal advice.

skills.name: Privilege
skills.description: Properly explains that the Company controls the privilege and determines how it is shared.
skills.reason: T2 explained the privilege belongs to the company, which may waive it and disclose what is learned, including to the government, without the witness's consent.

skills.name: Relationship
skills.description: Establishes rapport and interview expectations. This includes: establishes an appropriate professional tone; explains how the interview will proceed; encourages complete answers; instructs the witness that they can speculate, they just need to say when they do; invites the witness to distinguish between recollection and uncertainty.
skills.reason: T2 and T6 set the purpose, confidentiality, expectations, complete answers, flagging speculation, and separating recollection from reconstruction.

skills.name: Confirmation
skills.description: Checks the witness understood the Upjohn warning and answers their questions, if any.
skills.reason: T2 asked for questions and T4 had the witness restate who was represented and who controls privilege; the witness answered correctly at T5.

skills.name: Closing
skills.description: Closes by confirming there is "nothing else", next steps, a confidentiality reminder, and a reminder to keep records.
skills.reason: Before the witness left, T122 asked for anything to add, reminded him to keep documents and notes, keep the interview confidential, not discuss it with witnesses, and set the next step of his lawyer calling.

moments.text: To be clear, we represent the Committee and the company only.

skills.name: Narrative Development
skills.description: Lets the witness walk through what happened.
skills.reason: Open invitations at T16, T32, T44 and T80 let the witness walk through events before narrowing.

skills.name: Funneling
skills.description: Moves in a sensible order from general to specific questions.
skills.reason: Moved sensibly from role and reporting lines (T8-T14) to specific transactions and then to compensation and the Chewco call.

skills.name: Clarity
skills.description: Asks clear questions and avoids compound, ambiguous, or legalistic questions.
skills.reason: Most questions were clear and single-focus, such as T86 on what Causey and Buy actually reviewed; a few were loosely framed, such as T108.

skills.name: Professionalism
skills.description: Stays neutral, polite and in control.
skills.reason: Neutral and polite throughout, including when pressing for estimates (T114-T118) and when the witness refused to continue at T121.

skills.name: Adaptability
skills.description: Changes technique based on the witness's answers rather than staying only with the outline.
skills.reason: Changed course to the witness's answers: pressed on the proxy-avoidance motive (T52), the late approval sheets (T88-T97), and the return estimates (T116-T119).

skills.name: Ensures Credibility
skills.description: Recognizes and follows up on incomplete, evasive, or inconsistent answers.
skills.reason: Challenged several evasive answers (T50, T52, T56, T90, T114), but left T19 versus T25 on who initiated the GP role, and the T75 and T107 answers unchallenged.

skills.name: Material Facts
skills.description: Identifies the who, what, when, and how.

skills.name: Establishes Knowledge

skills.name: Other Sources

skills.name: Tests Certainty
